weaknesses: The abstract does not clearly specify the limitations of the proposed method, particularly regarding non-monotone loss functions.
While the paper discusses various extensions, it lacks empirical validation for some of these extensions, particularly in adversarial settings.
strengths: The paper presents a novel generalization of conformal prediction, extending its applicability to various loss functions beyond miscoverage.
The theoretical results are rigorous and provide strong guarantees for the proposed method, including clear connections to existing literature.
Empirical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm across multiple real-world applications, showcasing its practical utility.
